I made the edit to take out the second sentence but it was undone.  I'm just a lurker here so I'll leave it up to the bigger names, but I think this is incorrect.

In the chapter where Mat frees the windfinder, he takes the collar off her.  At this point obviously she is no longer a damane, he doesn't replace the collar.  He shows the windfinder how to open the collar while it is off her in my opinion and thus there is nothing special about the feat.
